items.title: James "Sing" Miller Interview, 1971-01-17
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, we were talking about Dave Oxley when he carried him off in the ambulance.

ctx.x: Yeah, you'll be back. Yeah, you'll be back.

Yeah, we were talking about Dave Oxley when he carried him off in the ambulance. I'll be back, I'll be back. Well, remember we were talking a little while ago about mentioning about Cap, and talking about all the different people, all the musicians who have died, and they've all been playing at Preservation Hall at one time or another. And—
One time somebody dies, somebody said they need a piano player up there. I said, you got two or three of them up there already, don't need me.
